facts.text: Deborah hosted a yoga class for her neighbors on Friday, which they embraced and enjoyed.

evidence.quote: My neighbors were interested in trying yoga, so I hosted a class for them on Friday. It was great to see everyone embrace and enjoy it.

facts.text: Deborah finds teaching yoga calming and believes it brings happiness by helping others and building community connections.

evidence.quote: I find it calming and wanted to share that with others. Giving people peace and awareness brings me so much happiness.
Teaching it is awesome because it can help others and I've made such great friends through it. It's really nice for building community connections.

facts.text: Jolene acknowledges Deborah's efforts in sharing yoga and notes the positive impact of having support in tough times.

evidence.quote: Wow, Deb! It's awesome when we can share something we love and make things better for others.
That's really motivating. It's great to have support in tough times.
